calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_quarter, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, first_fiscal_week, last_fiscal_week, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' ORDER BY fiscal_period

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_gross, SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_distinct_rl
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, o.status IS NULL AS no_order, o.status, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-15' AND DATE '2024-11-10'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (SELECT receipt_id, sum(gross_amount) g, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND abs(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND l.n<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) count_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_dispatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(o.dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE) <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) day_edge
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-07-15' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-11-10'
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
), mine AS (
SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_before FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.web_net, c.ctl_before, (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) dup_orders FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
